# Vendored: VITS_with_XPhoneBERT

- Source: https://github.com/VinAIResearch/XPhoneBERT/tree/7bd41b9912cc356a89e7de7ac596f42ba8b932c4/VITS_with_XPhoneBERT
- License: MIT (`LICENSE`, `text/LICENSE`), copyright Jaehyeon Kim (original VITS).
- Not copied: `__pycache__/`, `monotonic_align/build/`, prebuilt `.so`, LJSpeech filelists, `requirements.txt`
  (pins torch 1.6), and `monotonic_align/core.c` (regenerated by Cython at build time).

Every local change is marked with a `tts-amis patch` comment. Do not reformat these files (ruff excludes
`third_party/`), so `diff` against upstream stays readable.

| File | Patch | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `train.py` | Tokenizer from `app.xphonebert_tokenizer.load_xphonebert_tokenizer` instead of `AutoTokenizer` | transformers 5.x builds a byte-level BPE tokenizer for this repo that silently drops every tone, `▁`, `ʔ`, `ɤ̆` |
| `train.py` | `torch.amp.autocast('cuda')` / `GradScaler('cuda')` | `torch.cuda.amp` is deprecated |
| `train.py` | `hps.train.max_minutes` wall-clock limit; rank 0 broadcasts the stop flag; final checkpoint; `dist.destroy_process_group()` | Kaggle kills sessions at 12 h; ranks deciding on their own clocks could deadlock DDP |
| `train.py`, `utils.py` | Keep only the newest `G_*.pth` / `D_*.pth` (`utils.remove_old_checkpoints`) | ~1.5 GB per pair; Kaggle output is limited to 20 GB |
| `mel_processing.py` | `torch.stft(..., return_complex=True)` + `torch.view_as_real` | torch 2.x requires `return_complex` |
| `mel_processing.py` | `librosa_mel_fn(sr=..., n_fft=..., n_mels=..., fmin=..., fmax=...)` | librosa >= 0.10 is keyword-only |
| `utils.py` | `torch.load(..., weights_only=False)` | torch >= 2.6 default rejects checkpoints with optimizer state |
| `utils.py` | `np.asarray(fig.canvas.buffer_rgba())[..., :3]` | `tostring_rgb` was removed from matplotlib |
| `models.py` | `generate_path(...).float()` instead of `.type(torch.cuda.FloatTensor)` | inference crashed on CPU |
| `monotonic_align/setup.py` | `setuptools` instead of `distutils` | `distutils` is gone in Python >= 3.12 |
| `monotonic_align/__init__.py` | NumPy fallback `maximum_path_numpy` when the Cython extension is not built | local CPU smoke test on Windows (no C compiler); `tests/test_monotonic_align.py` checks it against `core.pyx` |
| `configs/amis_base_xphonebert.json` | New: 24 kHz, batch 16 per GPU, `max_text_len` 2000, `max_minutes`, `fp16_run` true, `eval_interval` 2000 | our dataset; derived from `lj_base_xphonebert.json`. fp16 + one T4 measured 0.78 s/step vs 1.59 (upstream fp32) and 9.3 with DDP on T4 x2 (`scripts/vits_profile.py`) |

`train.py` imports `app.xphonebert_tokenizer`, so the repo root must be on `PYTHONPATH` (the Kaggle kernel and
`scripts/vits_cpu_smoke.py` set this up).
